messages:
miranda (sales): @channel 🚨 NovaSoft POC hitting rate limits and intermittent 500s during test run. Demo with customer tomorrow 9am PST. Can eng/sre/solutions swarm now? We need a mitigation + timeline.


diego (solutions): On it. Can you paste the failing request example and any logs? Also how many concurrent sessions are they running?


miranda (sales): They ran a scripted load: ~40 concurrent users sending chat API requests, average seq len ~600 tokens. Attached snippet from their run:

```json
{"status":429, "error":"rate_limit_exceeded", "retry_after":1}
{"status":500, "error":"internal_server_error","trace":"runtime/kernels:oom?"}
```


miranda (sales): Customer is on trial hosted tier, not Dedicated. Pricing/commit question in-thread: if we recommend Dedicated for demo, how long to provision and rough delta in cost? @maya


maya (acctmgr): Dedicated can be provisioned in 24-48h for trials with fast-path, cost depends on size. I'll DM details to the rep. For the immediate demo we should aim for a short-term workaround.


sre_oncall: I see increased 429s on the hosted cluster for that org-id. Likely burst exceeded per-customer QPS cap + model backend saturation. I'll pull logs and check autoscaler events.


alex (eng-runtime): Two quick options: 1) route NovaSoft to a lower-cost/faster model variant with shorter context (e.g., redwood-7b-chat -> redwood-3b-chat) to reduce kernel time; 2) enable short-term rate override for their org (if approved) + enable aggressive client-side backoff. Also check for KV cache warmup missing.


diego (solutions): Miranda, do they need full fidelity answers for the demo or will approximate/shorter responses work? If shorter answers are acceptable, we can suggest model fallback.


miranda (sales): Customer wants coherent answers but short is ok for demo. They care about latency < 600ms median. Current p99 is ~2.3s.


sre_oncall: I found autoscaler thrash around 16:17 UTC and several model workers hit OOM retries. Logs show spike in sequence lengths > 1500 tokens for a small subset of requests (unexpected). Suggest enforce max_tokens at proxy to 800 for the POC.


miranda (sales): Can we do a temporary proxy-level token cap and retry with backoff? Who can flip that config?


alex (eng-runtime): I can add a per-org request transformer to enforce `max_tokens:800` and inject `retry_after` backoff headers in the next 20 minutes. Will need a quick feature flag and approval. Tagging @sre_oncall for risk.


sre_oncall: Fine from SRE side for a short window. Please log the change and rollback plan. Also I'll increase the org QPS soft limit by +25% for 2 hours to absorb the scripted load.


ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Starting canary: infra/ingress-transformer v2.3 -> 3 instances. CI checks passed. ETA ~8m.


diego (solutions): Meanwhile, can we also suggest client-side improvements: exponential backoff (jitter), response streaming, and using embeddings for short rerank instead of full generation for parts of the flow.


miranda (sales): I'll relay that to the customer now. Thanks. Also, pricing note: if Dedicated is recommended post-demo, rep will need a quote — maya to follow up.


maya (acctmgr): I'll prep a 30/90-day trial Dedicated quote and put placeholders for sizing. Will coordinate with finance after we know the expected QPS.


ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary deploy complete. ingress-transformer v2.3 live on 3/3 hosts.


alex (eng-runtime): Change applied: proxy now enforces `max_tokens:800` and attaches `x-retry-after-ms` header when returning 429s. Rolling config across edge in 5m. Watch for client errors.


sre_oncall: Increased org soft QPS by 25% at 16:42 UTC. Autoscaler stabilized, a few OOM retries still but below alert threshold.


miranda (sales): Customer re-ran test: p50 latency down to 520ms, p95 down to 1.1s, still occasional 500s (~1%). They reported demo-critical flows working. Good news.


diego (solutions): I'll follow up with a small config snippet for the customer to add client-side retry/backoff and a recommended model fallback list.


miranda (sales): Copy. Also they asked about security questionnaire items for Dedicated deployment (data residency + KMS). Who owns those docs?


maya (acctmgr): Security/compliance pack is on Confluence; I'll share link. For Dedicated we have KMS integration and VPC peering options; will loop in security team if they need SOC2/HIPAA attestation docs.


miranda (sales): Great. Final ask: can we mark this as POC-swarmed and write a short postmortem if we recommend Dedicated? Want to capture root causes (burst + long sequences + missing client backoff).


sre_oncall: Agreed. I'll capture timeline and mitigation steps. Diego, Alex — please provide root-cause notes on model OOMs and proxy change.


diego (solutions): Will do. I'll also draft a short migration plan to Dedicated if customer wants guaranteed latency for production.


miranda (sales): Thanks all — team saved the demo. I'll update NovaSoft and confirm the demo time tomorrow.


maya (acctmgr): I'll prepare the Dedicated quote and security doc links. Ping me if you need exec-level comms.


miranda (sales): Closing thread for now. Re-open if anything new arises. :thumbsup:"
